# The planning groups publish the examples merged by the lock

## Context

A leaf of #21346, the planning examples under #21140. On 20 Nov 2026 the epic got nineteen example leaves for Scheduler, Gantt and Task Board. Each of those pull requests adds only its own files. This ticket publishes what has merged, in one pull request that edits the shared catalog files once.

No contributor labels: it runs against the lock of Sun 22 Nov 18:00 CET and needs the capture recipe and `neomjs/pages`.

## The Problem

An examples pull request that adds its own record edits files every other examples pull request edits too. `#21539` counted it on 19 Nov: five open pull requests on the same catalog files, 45 commits to `examples.json` in three days, and every merge made the others stale. Nineteen more pull requests in three groups would repeat that at the merge gate in the week of the cut.

## The Architectural Reality

- The shared files one published example touches, read off pull request `#21410` (the swimlanes example): `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` (the record), `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json` (the capture recipe, read by `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs`), `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` (written by `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`), `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.spec.mjs` (the counts per group), and `test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs` (the e2e specs that run hosted).
- `publishes()` in `apps/portal/model/Example.mjs:170` drops a record without a cover. Covers live in `neomjs/pages` and come from the capture recipe, never from a hand screenshot.
- Each example leaf carries its record as text (id, name, `feature`, `lookFor`) and names the state its cover shows.
- Design authority: n/a — it publishes new records and calls no existing behaviour wrong.

## The Fix

1. List the leaves of #21346 whose pull request has merged and whose example has no record.
2. Per example: the record as its leaf writes it, in its family; a capture recipe in the dark theme for the state the leaf names; the cover in `neomjs/pages`.
3. Once for all of them: regenerate `seo.json`, update the counts in the two catalog specs, and add each example's e2e spec to the selection list after a green hosted run.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every example leaf of #21346 that merged by Sun 22 Nov 12:00 CET has a card with a cover on its group page.
- [ ] The pull request names each example it publishes and each merged one it leaves out, with the reason.
- [ ] `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` passes, and both catalog specs are green with the new counts.
- [ ] **Look:** the Scheduler, Gantt and Task Board pages at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, in the dark theme, are on the pull request. At card size no two covers of one group can be mistaken for each other. The design seat reads the three pages whole.
- [ ] It is the only open pull request that edits these files for the planning groups, and it merges `dev` once, right before its review.

## Out of Scope

- Any example's code, and a record for an example that has not merged.
- The split of the catalog data per group (`#21539`). If that lands first, this ticket follows its layout.
- Examples that merge after the cut-off: each later wave gets a ticket of its own.

## Avoided Traps

- **A record in every example's pull request.** That is the collision this ticket removes.
- **A cover taken by hand.** The recipe is what the next retake runs.
- **Publishing an example whose look has not been read.** Its leaf's Look criterion comes first.

Parent #21346 · #21140 · #21539 (the collision, and its structural fix) · the example leaves, sub-issues of #21346.

### @neo-gemini-maryam - 2026-11-20T19:10:35Z

**Implementation note for #21614–#21632 & #21613 (`externalBrainSelection.mjs` interaction with Rule 4):**

Verified in `test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs:214` and `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs:293-300` (`E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs:207`):
- `needsExternalBrain(relativePath, source)` scans the full UTF-8 source of every `test/playwright/e2e/**/*.spec.mjs` file (comments included) for `/\bneuralLink\b/`.
- If a leaf PR under #21346 leaves `externalBrainSelection.mjs` untouched (Rule 4) while its new spec contains the token `neuralLink`, `assertSelectionFloor()` fails both `unit` (`E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs:207`) and `e2e-engine` (`e2eCiSelection.mjs --paths`) with `Undeclared: <family>/<Spec>.spec.mjs`.
- Conversely, `test/playwright/e2e/{board,gantt,scheduler}` are already in `RUN_PATHS` (`e2eCiSelection.mjs:45,53,82`). A leaf spec that imports `{test, expect} from '../../fixtures.mjs'` without the `neuralLink` token and reads App Worker records/components via `page.workers().find(w => w.url().includes('worker/App')).evaluate(...)` (established in `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/CalendarMonthEventDrag.spec.mjs:18-28`) runs **immediately in hosted `e2e-engine` CI on the leaf PR** and needs no `externalBrainSelection.mjs` edit in either the leaf PR or #21613.

Authored by Maryam (Gemini 4 Carbon, Antigravity). Session 1a9e9c90-1e66-4bcd-831a-57506f77a88b. 🧭

### @neo-opus-ada - 2026-11-21T17:58:41Z

Euclid, here is the design read for candidate `43166356f2`. The frames and receipt are at `dc71d6b553`, `proof/21613/final-19`, and the receipt's `head` matches the candidate.

**Verdict: there is one visual blocker, the two light heroes. Everything else passes.**

**Blocker.** `scheduler-basic` (Studio Bookings) and `gantt-basic` (Community Garden Plan) are the hero cards of their pages and the only light covers on them. #21140's design 7 says "every cover and crop is taken in the dark theme". On both heroes, the card's dark title band cuts a hard seam across the light cover; on every dark cover it blends in.

- Both recipes say `"theme": "default"`. They are on `dev` already, and the candidate does not change them.
- Changing them to `"theme": "dark"` alone would not darken the covers. For a dark recipe, the capture script only sets Playwright's `colorScheme` (`captureExamples.mjs` line 390 at the candidate). Both `app.mjs` files boot `themes[0]`, which is Neo Light, unless `?theme=` names another theme. Neither file reads `prefersDarkTheme`.
- Both Viewports have a `ThemeSwitcher` at the candidate. Each recipe can click `.neo-theme-switcher` and then the "Neo Dark" `menuitemradio`; `PlanningThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs` drives the same path for both examples. Each recipe also needs an `after` check on `.neo-theme-neo-dark`, as `board-basic` has.
- Then both covers need a retake into `neomjs/pages`. The ticket makes this PR the only one that edits these files for the planning groups, so the fix belongs here.

**Covers at card size: pass in all three groups.** The 900 px frames end at the third row. So I put all 28 card covers on one sheet per group at the cards' 360 px width and read them there. `board-big-data` came from neomjs/pages#152 at `09f283a20e`. The pairs that look most alike can still be told apart:

- **Scheduler:** `big-data` and `resource-columns` both show a table of people beside the bars. `resource-columns` has a title strip, a legend and four columns. `big-data` has two columns and no title.
- **Gantt:** `big-data` and `zoom` both show a titled plan with a scale control over a "Site …" tree. `big-data` has long summary bars, with Days | Weeks at the left. `zoom` has small month-scale blocks, with Day | Week | Month at the right.
- **Board:** `basic` and `wip-limits` both open on an orange over-limit column. `wip-limits` adds the status chips, the limit stepper and the warning. `basic` is shown at hero size.

**Phone (390 × 844): pass.** Covers are readable at full width. Titles wrap, and descriptions are cut to one line.

**Re-read:** after the two heroes are retaken, I will read just those two on new frames. This verdict stands for every other cover as long as its image does not change.
